find: if (cells.every(([c, r]) => r === r0 || c === c0)) return { run: Math.max(w, h), arm: Math.min(w, h) - 1 };
replace: if (cells.every(([c, r]) => r === r0 || c === c0)) return { run: Math.max(w, h), arm: Math.min(w, h) };
why: The arm keeps the corner cell, which belongs to the straight run, so every L-arm length reads one cell long and the reported arm distribution stops matching what `runs` draws (2-5 cells at the defaults).
killedBy: the run-length read-back (issue #1029) reads a straight run, and an L's longer leg as the run and its shorter leg less the corner as the arm
the run-length read-back (issue #1029) sums the components and summarises the lengths over a sample of boards
